description: Synthetic engineering decisions. No private tasks, identities, infrastructure, or credentials. Ten target memories, twenty distractors, fifty frozen questions.

documents.title: Payment webhook deduplication
documents.content: The checkout service stores the provider event identifier with a unique database constraint. Repeated delivery returns success without charging the customer again. Retain event identifiers for seven days.

documents.title: Release approval boundary
documents.content: Production deployment requires a human approval record for the exact artifact digest. A chat message or model claim is insufficient. Changing the build invalidates approval.

documents.title: Search cache invalidation
documents.content: Invalidate retrieval entries after a task update or deletion. The corpus cache expires after five minutes. Never persist an incomplete corpus when a source backend fails.

documents.title: Tenant export authorization
documents.content: Every export job checks organization membership before reading records. Resolve the organization from the authenticated session, not the request body. Background jobs repeat the check when they execute.

documents.title: Queue retry backoff
documents.content: Retry transient worker failures with exponential backoff and jitter. Stop after five attempts and place the job in the dead letter queue. Validation errors are permanent and must not be retried.

documents.title: Database migration rollback
documents.content: Use expand and contract schema changes. Add the new nullable column first; backfill before switching readers. Retain the old column until the previous application version can no longer be rolled back.

documents.title: Customer support escalation
documents.content: Refund requests exceeding the automated allowance require a support supervisor. The assistant drafts a response, records the escalation, and waits. It cannot authorize the refund itself.

documents.title: Credential log redaction
documents.content: Remove authorization headers and API tokens before writing diagnostic logs. Preserve request identifiers and status codes. Test redaction using synthetic values; never use production credentials in fixtures.

documents.title: Document ingestion size limits
documents.content: Reject uploaded files larger than ten megabytes before parsing. Permit PDF and plain text only. Quarantine documents whose parser times out; do not silently index a partial extraction.

documents.title: Calendar booking timezone
documents.content: Store appointment instants in UTC and retain the customer's IANA timezone for display. Ambiguous daylight saving times require the caller to choose an offset before a booking is accepted.

documents.title: Payment invoice layout
documents.content: Invoice PDF headers contain the order number and billing address. Format currency with two decimal places. This is independent of webhook delivery handling.

documents.title: Payment method display
documents.content: Show the last four card digits on the checkout confirmation. Do not store the full card number. Customers may choose bank transfer.

documents.title: Release notes template
documents.content: List new features, fixes, and compatibility changes. Link each item to its tracking issue. Publishing release notes does not deploy production.

documents.title: Release artifact retention
documents.content: Keep signed build artifacts for ninety days. Development snapshots expire after a week. Artifact storage is separate from human approval records.

documents.title: Search result rendering
documents.content: Display the title and a short content excerpt. Escape HTML before rendering. Show the source project for each result.

documents.title: Search keyboard navigation
documents.content: Arrow keys move through search results. Enter opens the selected task. Escape closes the search dialog.

documents.title: Tenant branding settings
documents.content: Each organization may set a logo and accent color. Validate image dimensions during upload. Branding does not determine access permissions.

documents.title: Tenant usage report
documents.content: Show daily request totals grouped by organization. Account owners can download a usage chart after authorization. The chart contains no record content.

documents.title: Queue monitoring dashboard
documents.content: Display job counts and oldest pending job age. Alert on a sustained backlog. The dashboard never changes retry policy.

documents.title: Queue priority labels
documents.content: High priority jobs run before ordinary jobs. Preserve insertion order inside a priority class. Interactive requests use the high priority class.

documents.title: Database connection pool
documents.content: Bound each worker to ten database connections. Close idle connections after one minute. Monitor connection acquisition latency.

documents.title: Database backup schedule
documents.content: Take an encrypted backup every night. Exercise recovery monthly. Backups are separate from application schema migration sequencing.

documents.title: Customer support response tone
documents.content: Use concise and respectful language. Cite the relevant help article. Ask one clarifying question when the request lacks an order number.

documents.title: Customer support office hours
documents.content: The staffed desk operates on weekdays. Outside office hours the assistant records requests for the next shift. Opening hours do not grant refund authority.

documents.title: Credential rotation schedule
documents.content: Rotate service tokens every month. Record the owner and next rotation date. Expired tokens are revoked after the replacement is deployed.

documents.title: Diagnostic log retention
documents.content: Delete routine request logs after thirty days. Keep incident records according to the retention policy. The retention job does not perform token redaction.

documents.title: Document search snippets
documents.content: Extract a short passage around matching terms for search results. Keep page numbers for PDF citations. Snippet generation happens after ingestion succeeds.

documents.title: Document storage encryption
documents.content: Encrypt accepted uploads at rest. Generate a separate storage key per account. Deleting a document removes its encrypted object.

documents.title: Calendar reminder delivery
documents.content: Send a reminder one hour before an accepted appointment. Cancel reminders when the appointment is removed. Reminder transport uses the notification queue.

documents.title: Calendar availability window
documents.content: Offer appointments at least two hours in the future. Limit booking to the next thirty days. Availability is calculated before timezone confirmation.
